newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain presents share offer 21.01 pct Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Spain presents share offer 21.01 pct Telefonica.

text.p: Spain presented a share offer for 21.01 percent of telecoms operator Telefonica de Espana with a maximum of 196.74 million shares, the national stock market commission CNMV said on Friday.

The state, which is offering 20.9 percent through its holding company SEPPa and another 0.11 percent through its main holding company, still has to set the final number and price of the shares, the CNMV said in a statement.

SEPPa's board of directors will also set the number of shares reserved for each tranche, for a greenshoe and for a "loyalty bonus" to retail purchasers who hold onto their new shares for at least a year.
The offer will be divided into domestic and international tranches with the domestic tranche split between institutional and retail buyers, with a subtranche for employees and Telefonica pensioners.
The international tranche will be divided into four regional offers: the United States, the United Kingdom and Ireland, continental Europe and the rest of the world.
Retail investors will get a four percent discount off the market reference price of the shares and one free share for every 20 as a "loyalty bonus."
The special tranche for employees or pensioners of Telefonica and its majority-owned subsidiaries may carry added incentives, which will be spelled out when details of the share offer are finalised.
A certain number of shares will be set aside as a green shoe, which is a reserve in case the offer is oversubscribed.
No exact dates were given for the sale, but SEPPa is planning to open an information office for potential investors from January 20 through February 14.
Global coordinators for the sale are: Argentaria, Banco Bilbao de Viscaya, La Caixa and Morgan Stanley.

Domestic directors for the institutional tranche are Argentaria, BBV, La Caixa, Banco Central Hispano-BCH and Banco Santander with Caja de Madrid in addition for the retail tranche. The Banco Exterior de Espana-BEX will be named as the agent bank managing the offer.
